Hi all —

Quick update from infra: we’ve had a partial outage in our primary west region overnight that impacted a subset of sandbox VPCs. The on-call Ops lead asked we pause any live demos that rely on our sandbox until we confirm stability (likely a 48–72h window). Also, heads-up — two members of our infra team are traveling Thurs and Friday for an on-site incident response which reduces duplicate coverage.

Given that, we need to push the demo off Nov 23. Our procurement team also asked for the MAP to include estimated timelines for SOC evidence and data retention — I CC’d them above.

Possible constraint: we still have a short window for a high-level, non-sandbox walkthrough (slides + recorded clip) if Redwood can do a degraded demo that doesn’t touch our sandbox. Otherwise prefer to move to next week.

— CloudWave Ops (Jenny for the team)

- Degraded/demo-lite plan: yes — I can run a non-sandbox walkthrough using a local sandbox capture (recorded) + live Q&A. - Availability: I’m on travel Nov 23–24 (limited connection). I am available for live sessions Mon Nov 30 and Tue Dec 1 (all day PT). I can cover a lite session on Nov 23 if we keep it strictly slides + recorded clip and I join by phone for Q&A (limited demo access).
- SE note for procurement: attached below is a short stub describing typical SOC evidence timelines (SOC2: usually provide consolidated evidence within 2–3 weeks after initial request; audit package timelines vary).
